greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabad iyo nimco ha idinla jirto idinka oo dhan oo maanta halkan isugu yimid si aynu u raadinno wajiga Ilaah.
penitential: Sayidow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Sayidow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Beerta canabka ah ee Rabbigu waa reer binu Israa'iil.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kaceyso oo aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay tahay mid qabow oo qoto dheer, adigoo fiirinaya booska uu Benjamin Vo mar walba fadhiisan jiray, adigoo xusuusanaya tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee wiilkaaga. Maanta, adigoo jooga meeshan, waxaan eegaynaa qolka uu Benjamin ku qaatay saacadihiisa aamusnaanta, halkaas oo ay ku yaalliin buugaagtiisa teknoolojiyadda, kombuyuutarradiisa, iyo sawirrada diyaaradaha uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya akhriyin buugaagta, laakiin dhisayey fikirkiisa ku saabsan nolosha. Halkaas ayaynu ka billaabaynaa maanta, annagoo aan degdegeyn, annagoo si dhab ah u eegaya noloshaas quruxda badan ee uu Ilaahay inoo dhiibay mudada kooban.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'geedka canabka ah'. Akhriska koowaad ee nebi Isayaas, waxaan ka maqlaynaa hees ku saabsan saaxiib daryeelay beertiisa canabka ah. Wuxuu ka saaray dhagaxyada, wuxuu beeray geedo la doortay, wuxuuna dhisay munaarad uu ku ilaaliyo. Laakiin beertii waxay dhashay canab duurjoog ah. Ciise, Injiilka maanta, wuxuu sheekadan u adeegsanayaa si uu u muujiyo sida Ilaah uu u daryeelay dadkiisa, laakiin ay ugu jawaabeen diidmo. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa geed canab ah oo si qurux badan loo daryeelay. Xusuusnow sida uu u jeclaa inuu 'airport spotting' sameeyo, isagoo eegaya diyaaradaha oo ka kacaya garoomada adduunka, isagoo ku riyoonaya 'Con Chim Airlines'. Wuxuu ahaa wiil indhihiisu ay u furnaayeen xaqiiqda ah in dunidu ay ka weyn tahay waxa aan maanta aragno.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay ahaayeen kuwo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira waqtiyo habeenkii ah oo ay codadka gurigu aamusaan, oo ay xusuustaadu kusoo dhacdo dhoola-caddayntii Ben markii uu ku oran jiray 'Good morning, Dad.' Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkaan si tartiib ah u joojino oo aan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Xusuusnow, xataa markii uu 15 sano jir ahaa, Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbi saafi ah oo rabay inuu u huro wax walba uu haysto si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Taasi waa dabeecadda wiilka aad koriseen, waana midda Ilaah uu ku farxo.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu ku hadlayaa dhagaxa ay dhismayaashu iska tuureen, kaas oo noqday dhagaxii xagasha. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiilkaas yar ee adduunkani laga yaabo inuu u arkay inuu 'dhacay', laakiin xagga Ilaah, wuxuu noqday dhagaxii xagasha ee dhisaya rajada qoyskiisa. Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa meel aanay jirin daal, meel aanay jirin baahida loo qabo in la sugo diyaarad ama la dhiso shirkad. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo la jooga malaa'igta. Wuxuu idin leeyahay, iyadoo dhoola caddaynaya: 'Ha murugoonina.'

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeeyey inaad ku jirto Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jeclahay wax walba, waxaanan rabaa inaan naftayda kuu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata, fadlan ku imow qalbigayga si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii inaad horey u joogtay, waxaanan ku mideynayaa naftayda adiga. Ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Nabadgelyo, Ilaahay ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin xoojiyo. Waxaan ku sagootinayaa nabadda Masiixa.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan dadka dhintay, inuu Ilaah u naxariisto oo uu siiyo nabad weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah ku dhiirrigeliyo rajo iyo nabad qalbigooda.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Haatan waxaan u gabayaa saaxiibkay, hees ku saabsan beertiisa canabka ah. Saaxiibkay wuxuu beertiisa canabka ah ku lahaa buur bacrin ah; wuu qoday, dhagaxyadii wuu ka saaray, wuxuuna beeray geedo canab ah oo la doortay; dhexdeedana wuxuu ka dhisay munaarad, wuxuuna ka qoday meel canabka lagu tijaabiyo. Markaasuu sugay inay dhasho canab, laakiin waxay dhashay canab duurjoog ah. Haddaba, dadka reer Yeruusaalem iyo dadka reer Yahuudahow, dhex-dhexaad ka noqda aniga iyo beertayda canabka ah: Maxaa kale oo aan u samayn waayay beertayda canabka ah oo aanan u samayn? Maxay, markii aan sugayay inay dhasho canab, u dhashay canab duurjoog ah? Haddaba waxaan idin ogeysiinayaa waxaan ku samayn doono beertayda canabka ah: Waxaan ka qaadi doonaa xayndaabkeeda, waana la daaqi doonaa, gidaarkeeda waan dumin doonaa, waana la tuman doonaa! Haa, waxaan ka dhigi doonaa burbur: lagama jari doono, lagumana qodi doono, laakiin waxaa ka bixi doona qodxan iyo geedo yaryar; waxaan amri doonaa daruuraha inayna roob ku soo daynin. Beerta canabka ah ee Rabbiga ciidammadu waa reer binu Israa'iil, dadka reer Yahuudahna waa geedkiisa la doortay; wuxuu sugay cadaalad, laakiin fiiri, dhiig-daadin! Wuxuu sugay xaqnimo, laakiin maqla qaylada!

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Beerta canabka ah ee Rabbigu waa reer binu Israa'iil. Waxaad Masar ka soo guurtay geed canab ah; waad eryday quruumaha, waadna beeratay. Waxay laamo u dirtay badda, laamaheedana waxay gaadheen webiga. R. Beerta canabka ah ee Rabbigu waa reer binu Israa'iil. Maxaad u duminaysaa gidaarkeeda, si uu midhaheeda u gurto qof kasta oo maraya, bahalkii duurka ka yimaadaana uu u baabbi'iyo, xayawaankii duurka ku jiraana uu u cuno? R. Beerta canabka ah ee Rabbigu waa reer binu Israa'iil. Rabbiyow, mar kale xagga jannada ka soo eeg, oo arag; daryeel geedkan canabka ah, oo ilaali waxa gacantaada midig ay beeratay, wiilka aadanaha ee aad naftaada ka dhigtay mid xooggan. R. Beerta canabka ah ee Rabbigu waa reer binu Israa'iil. Markaas mar dambe kaama fogaan doonno; nolol cusub na sii, oo magacaaga ayaannu ku baryi doonnaa. Rabbiyow, Ilaaha ciidammadow, na soo celi; haddii wajigaagu nagu iftiimo, markaas waa la inoo badbaadin doonaa. R. Beerta canabka ah ee Rabbigu waa reer binu Israa'iil.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow, waxba ha ka welwelina, laakiin wax walba baryo iyo ducadaada, adigoo mahadnaqaya, Ilaah u soo bandhig codsiyadaada. Markaas nabadda Ilaah oo ka sarreysa fahamka oo dhan ayaa waardiyeyn doonta qalbiyadiinna iyo maskaxdiinna xagga Ciise Masiix. Ugu dambayntii, walaalayaalow, wax kasta oo run ah, wax kasta oo sharaf leh, wax kasta oo xaq ah, wax kasta oo nadiif ah, wax kasta oo qurux badan, wax kasta oo mahadsan, haddii ay jirto wax heer sare ah iyo haddii ay jirto wax mudan in la ammaano, ka fikir waxyaalahan. Ku sii wad waxaad iga baratay oo aad heshay oo aad maqashay oo aad igu aragtay. Markaas Ilaaha nabadda ayaa idinla jiri doona.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu ku yiri wadaaddadii sare iyo odayaashii dadka: "Maqal masaal kale. Waxaa jiray nin beeralay ah oo beeray beerta canabka ah, xayndaab ku wareejiyay, meel canabka lagu tijaabiyo ka qoday, munaaradna ka dhisay. Markaasuu u kireeyay beeralay, safarna wuu u baxay. Markii wakhtigii midhaha la guran lahaa uu soo dhowaaday, ayuu u diray addoommadiisii beeralayda si ay u soo qaadaan midhaha. Laakiin beeralaydii waxay qabteen addoommadii, midna way garaaceen, midna way dileen, kii saddexaadna dhagax ayay ku dileen. Mar kale ayuu u diray addoommo kale, kuwaas oo ka badnaa kuwii hore, laakiin siday ula dhaqmeen kuwii hore ayay ula dhaqmeen. Ugu dambayntii, wuxuu u diray wiilkiisii, isagoo u malaynaya, 'Way ixtiraami doonaan wiilkayga.' Laakiin markii beeralaydii arkeen wiilka, waxay isku yiraahdeen, 'Kan waa kii dhaxalka lahaa. Kaalaya, aan dilno, oo aynu qaadanno dhaxalkiisa.' Waxay qabteen wiilkiisii, waxayna ka tuureen beertii canabka ahayd, wayna dileen. Maxuu sameyn doonaa beeralayga beerta canabka ah marka uu yimaado?" Waxay ugu jawaabeen, "Wuxuu u dhiman doonaa dhimasho xun ninkaas xun, wuxuuna beertiisa u kireyn doonaa beeralay kale oo siin doona midhaha wakhtigooda." Ciise wuxuu ku yiri, "Miyaanaydin weligiin Qorniinka ka akhriyin: Dhagaxii ay dhismayaashu diideen wuxuu noqday dhagaxii xagasha; Rabbiga ayaa tan sameeyay, waana wax lala yaabo indhaheenna? Sidaa darteed, waxaan idinku leeyahay, boqortooyada Ilaah waa laga qaadi doonaa idinka, waxaana la siin doonaa dad soo saara midhaheeda."

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
